# Intents

> Test Apple Foundation Models before you ship: a free, open-source native Mac workbench for repeatable cases, responses, traces, and saved comparisons.

Made by Cory Parry; MIT licensed. Intents was previously Foundation Evals. As checked 4 October 2026, the released download is Foundation Evals v1.3.0 (20 September 2026). Current source adds Review, Batch runs, and Intent Lab (beta); these are not in the v1.3.0 installer. The 1.4.0 release remains pending.

macOS 27+. The default on-device model needs an Apple Intelligence-capable Apple silicon Mac, Apple Intelligence enabled, and its model downloaded. Xcode 27 is needed for source builds and Intent Lab, not ordinary suites. Remote providers and judges use their configured services. Siri uses recognized text on a paired physical iPhone, not microphone audio. Direct App Intent success does not prove Siri routing or observed app effects. Current source uses authenticated local MCP; v1.3.0 uses credential-free localhost MCP. Website examples are historical browser recreations, not model benchmarks.

## Product and first use

- [Product overview](https://intents-workbench.coryparry.chatgpt.site/index.html.md): Release/source distinction, requirements, limitations, and historical example provenance.
- [Getting started](https://intents-workbench.coryparry.chatgpt.site/getting-started.html.md): Choose a build, create a small evaluation, and inspect evidence.
- [Interactive showcase](https://intents-workbench.coryparry.chatgpt.site/): Browser recreations of a 17 September run and historical PR54 fixture; predates Review and Batch runs.

## Released download

- [Foundation Evals 1.3.0 release](https://github.com/coryparrry/Intents/releases/tag/v1.3.0): Published installer, notes, and checksums.
- [v1.3.0 instructions](https://github.com/coryparrry/Intents/blob/v1.3.0/README.md): Released interface and MCP behavior.

## Development source and guides

- [Repository and builds](https://github.com/coryparrry/Intents): Current source; Xcode 27 needed to build.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/coryparrry/Intents/blob/main/docs/wiki/Getting-started.md): Current source controls.
- [User guide](https://github.com/coryparrry/Intents/blob/main/docs/wiki/Home.md): Workflows and evidence boundaries.
- [Review guide](https://github.com/coryparrry/Intents/blob/main/docs/EVAL_REVIEW_GUIDE.md): Human verdicts, regression cases, and held-out judge checks.
- [Batch guide](https://github.com/coryparrry/Intents/blob/main/docs/PRODUCTION_EVALS_GUIDE.md): Frozen datasets, resumable jobs, and release reports.
- [Intent Lab](https://github.com/coryparrry/Intents/blob/main/docs/wiki/Intent-Lab.md): App-owned support, signing, and distinct direct/Siri evidence.
- [Swift integration](https://github.com/coryparrry/Intents/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPER_SWIFT_INTEGRATION.md): Registered feature closures on paired apps.
- [MCP guide](https://github.com/coryparrry/Intents/blob/main/docs/wiki/Codex-and-MCP.md): Current authenticated local integration.
- [MIT licence](https://github.com/coryparrry/Intents/blob/main/LICENSE): Source terms.
